scope: CPU layer-internal DART reference lesson, not a navigation evaluation
text_pool: All sequence positions after the last image-token span, including vision_end and chat suffix
budget_rule: Per-image ceil(N * keep_ratio), including visual pivots; distribute remaining quota by divmod across original pivots
pivot_order: Visual pivots then text pivots; each ranked by descending K L1 with lower sequence index breaking ties
similarity: Lowest cosine of final-normed boundary hidden states; score in FP32; lower index breaks ties
adaptation_note: Layer-internal DART mechanism adapted for multiple images, exact budgets and deterministic ordering; not embedding-level pruning or a verbatim official implementation
